authentication.credential_source: settings.openmetadata_auth_token — sourced from environment / .env only; never hardcoded
authentication.credential_present_in_env_note: Determined by grepping env and .env for OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN; V2-P01 records only the presence boolean, never any value.
authentication.token_redaction: OpenMetadataClient.__repr__ emits 'auth_token=***' when a token is set (openmetadata_client.py:57-62). Verified by tests/unit/integrations/openmetadata/test_openmetadata_client.py::test_openmetadata_client_bearer_auth_and_masking (line 50).
authentication.identity_type_when_configured: bot / service account (recommended per V2-P01 §9); T2S itself does not distinguish user identity at the OM layer.
authentication.server_identifier_recorded: settings.openmetadata_url — recorded in manifests without credentials.

read_only_enforcement.current_verdict: PASS — client only calls httpx.Client.get(); no write methods exposed

tls.insecure_mode_flag: none — client uses httpx defaults (TLS on, system CA bundle)
tls.note: V2-P01 does not add TLS controls; if a LAB deployment requires a custom CA, that hardening is deferred to the deployment phase.

timeouts.note: Fixed connect/read constants live in openmetadata_client.py:37-38; only total is configurable via settings.

retries_and_backoff.note: Non-jittered backoff is acceptable at LAB scale; a jitter refactor is deferred until performance evidence requires it.

error_taxonomy.OPENMETADATA_TIMEOUT_OR_TRANSIENT: MetadataSyncError — 429/5xx after retries exhausted, or transport error
error_taxonomy.OPENMETADATA_SCHEMA_MAPPING_ERROR: MetadataMappingError — incomplete OM entity identity (raised in table_mapper)
error_taxonomy.OPENMETADATA_PAGINATION_EXCEEDED: MetadataCardinalityLimitExceededError — pagination or cardinality cap tripped
error_taxonomy.OPENMETADATA_EMPTY_CATALOG_note: empty list is a legitimate outcome when the pilot FQNs resolve to nothing; the provider does not conflate empty with unavailable — an unreachable server surfaces MetadataSyncError, not [].
error_taxonomy.note: All errors sanitized via t2s.security.error_sanitizer.sanitize_error_message before logging (openmetadata_client.py:197, 201, 232, 242, 251; openmetadata_provider.py:114, 118).

authorization_boundary.metadata_visibility_note: OpenMetadata visibility does NOT confer database SELECT privilege (V2-P01 §24). SqlAccessValidator and the read-only DB executor remain the authoritative gates.
runtime_authorization_layers_preserved: AuthorizationService / AuthorizedSqlResource — restricts which tables the runtime is allowed to expose to the solver
SqlAccessValidator — AST-level re-check on the generated SQL
read-only DB executor — connection-level query_only enforcement (postgres READ ONLY transaction; sqlite mode=ro URI)
authorization_boundary.metadata_acl_gap_disclosed: OpenMetadata bot access is coarse-grained; T2S retrieves what the bot can see, then filters through AuthorizationService before the solver. Per-user OM visibility filtering is METADATA_ACL_GAP and is out of scope for V2-P01.

pii_and_sample_data_boundary.evidence: DEFAULT_TABLE_FIELDS = 'columns,tags,owner,domain,tableConstraints,database,databaseSchema,service,extension' (openmetadata_client.py:23) — does NOT include sampleData, profile, queryHistory, lineage, columnStats, customProperties. Guarded by test_default_openmetadata_fields_exclude_sensitive_or_uncertified_data.
